theater: 重慶山城與合州釣魚城

battle.name: 余玠防蜀之戰
battle.theater: 重慶山城與合州釣魚城
battle.brief: 嘉熙六年（1242）末，宋廷命余玠兼四川宣撫使出鎮四川，1243年春入蜀，駐重慶以拒蒙古。成都、嘉定先後淪陷，蜀中諸軍各自為政，余玠改採依山築城、儲糧屯田的守禦方針，遣孟珙建議在嘉陵江與涪江匯流處築釣魚城。蒙古攻城用砲石、雲梯，宋方不與爭攻城之器，以山城弓弩與地勢固守。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 嘉熙六年（1242）末到七年（1243），四川的交戰形勢是南宋與蒙古帝國的對峙。南宋方面，朝廷在四川設四川宣撫司兼制置司，統轄成都府路、潼川府路、利州路、夔州路，宣撫使兼制置使為最高長官，下面分設各軍、州、縣的鎮戍與寨堡；兵源是四川原有軍戶、荊湖與襄漢流移入蜀的軍民、收編的潰兵與降眾。糧餉有三條來路：朝廷撥給的錢糧、沿長江由襄陽順流而下再溯嘉陵江入蜀的荊襄軍需、以及川中各州縣的稅收與屯田，三條線有一條斷掉，重慶就守不住。蒙古方面，這時大汗已經是定宗貴由，漢地軍務歸忽必烈總領；蒙古在四川沒有設行省，而是以西夏故地鞏昌路為基地，用漢地軍官與色目、探馬赤軍人混編的隊伍，經洮州、岷州、文州、興元三條路分次入蜀。前此蒙古軍自1236年起數度深入川中，成都、嘉定等大城先後陷落，蜀中府庫括盡、兵力耗散，州縣多淪為蒙古的羈縻之地；宋廷亦曾一度收復成都、嘉定與沿江諸縣，形成蒙軍據點與宋軍寨堡犬牙交錯的局面。1243年雙方的實際接觸，集中於川東的重慶、合州、夔州一線。
countriesEn: From the end of the Jiaxi sixth year (1242) into the seventh year (1243) the situation in Sichuan was a confrontation between the Southern Song and the Mongol Empire. On the Song side, the court maintained a Sichuan xuanfu office combined with a zhizhi office in Sichuan, with jurisdiction over the circuits of Chengdu, Tongchuan, Lizhou and Kizhou. The xuanfu commissioner, who also held the post of zhizhi commissioner, was the highest authority, and below him stood the garrisons, prefectures and county forts of the various circuits and armies. The troops came from the military households of Sichuan proper, from soldiers and civilians who had shifted into Sichuan from Jinghu and the Xiang-Han region, and from broken units and surrendered men taken into service. Three channels supplied the food and pay: money and grain sent down by the court, military stores from Jingxiang brought down the Yangtze and then up the Jialing to enter Sichuan, and the taxes and military farms of the Sichuan prefectures themselves. If any one of those three channels was cut, Chongqing could not be held. On the Mongol side, the Great Khan by then was Güyük, and the administration of the Chinese lands had been given to Kublai. The Mongols had set up no provincial administration in Sichuan; instead they used Gongchang circuit, the former territory of Western Xia, as a base, and their columns were mixed formations of Han Chinese troops under Han Chinese officers together with Semu and tanma-chi warriors, entering Sichuan by three roads in turn, through Tao, Min and Wenzhou in the north and through Xingyuan in the northwest. Earlier, from 1236 the Mongol armies had pushed into Sichuan more than once; the great cities of Chengdu and Jiading had fallen in turn, the treasuries of the province had been emptied, the manpower had been spent, and most prefectures and counties had become Mongol dependency territories. The Song had at one point retaken Chengdu, Jiading and the counties along the river, so that Mongol strongholds and Song forts stood interlocked like the teeth of two saws. The actual contact between the two sides in 1243 was concentrated on the eastern front around Chongqing, Hezhou and Kizhou.
people: 余玠（1198—1253），字子銳，潭州瀏陽人，是這場戰爭宋方的主帥。嘉熙六年（1242）末，朝廷任命他以兵部侍郎兼四川宣撫使出鎮四川，經臨安廷對之後，1243年春率師入蜀，駐重慶視事。此前川中將帥各自為政，遇敵則退，議事則推諉；余玠到任後整頓軍紀、汰除老弱、統一號令，又從糧餉與屯田兩頭下手，把重慶建成可以長期固守的大本營。他的防禦方針可以概括為一句話：憑山築城，據險而守。1253年他被朝廷罷職，蜀人聞之哭之，他在赴任途中病逝。孟珙是關鍵的幕後參謀。時任荊湖制置使的孟珙在收復襄陽之後轉而籌劃全線，他看出四川平原地區的城市無險可守，寫信給余玠，力主在嘉陵江與涪江交匯處築城設險，此地即後來的釣魚城；並承諾由荊襄沿江運糧，供給蜀中。這一策被余玠採納。合州方向的守將王堅是余玠在川中最倚重的將領之一，釣魚城的修築與屯守由他主持，後來這座城在1259年頂住了蒙哥汗的全力攻擊。蒙古一方要提防的是劉整，他原是南宋的瀘州安撫使，1242年率部降蒙古，此後成為蒙古南下的主要參謀，主張先取襄陽、斷宋糧道。忽必烈於1241年奉命總領漠南漢地軍務，1243年正率軍南下假道宋境，川外的大戰與川內的守禦同時進行，這是余玠能站穩腳步的外部條件。
peopleEn: Yu Jie (1198-1253), courtesy name Zirui, a native of Liuyang in Tanzhou, was the commander on the Song side in this war. At the end of the Jiaxi sixth year (1242) the court appointed him to take up the post of Sichuan xuanfu commissioner together with that of commissioner of the Sichuan defence, and after his audience at Lin'an he marched his troops into Sichuan in the spring of 1243 and took up his duties at Chongqing. Before him the commanders in Sichuan had each gone his own way, retiring before the enemy and passing the buck when decisions had to be taken. Once Yu Jie arrived he reformed the army discipline, retired the old and the feeble, unified the command signals, and worked at both ends of the supply problem, on the one hand the food and pay and on the other the military farms, turning Chongqing into a base that could be held for a long time. His doctrine of defence can be summed up in a phrase: build the city on the mountain and hold the position on its natural strength. In 1253 he was dismissed by the court, the people of Sichuan wept when they heard, and he fell ill and died on the road back to his post. Meng Gong was the decisive adviser behind the scenes. As commissioner of Jinghu he had retaken Xiangyang and then turned his mind to the whole front, and he could see that the cities of the Sichuan plain had no natural strength to hold them. In a letter to Yu Jie he urged that a fortress be built where the Jialing and the Fu rivers meet, the site that would later be Diaoyu Fortress, and he undertook to bring grain down the river from Jingxiang to feed Sichuan. The plan was taken up by Yu Jie. Wang Jian, the commander in the Hezhou direction, was one of the officers Yu Jie relied on most in Sichuan; he supervised the building and the garrison of Diaoyu Fortress, and in 1259 that city withstood the full weight of the assault of Möngke Khan. On the Mongol side the man to watch was Liu Zheng, who had been the Song xuanfu commissioner of Luzhou and who defected to the Mongols with his troops in 1242, thereafter becoming the chief adviser of the Mongol advance into the south and arguing for taking Xiangyang first in order to cut the Song supply line. Kublai had been ordered in 1241 to take overall charge of military affairs in the Han lands south of the desert, and in 1243 he was marching south with borrowed passage through Song territory, so that a major campaign outside Sichuan and the defence inside it were running at the same time, which was the external condition that allowed Yu Jie to hold his ground.
kits: 卡面這件配重投石車，是12世紀歐洲已經定型的攻城器械：以長桿作臂，一端吊著配重，另一端裝兜，拋石時靠配重下墜把石彈甩過城牆或砸向城內的密集隊形。它在中國的落地時間比歐洲晚得多，一般認為是蒙古西征之後由西域的砲手連同技術一起帶進中國，中原把它叫做回回砲，《宋史·兵志》把它列為攻城利器之一。1243年的川中戰線上，這件武器尚未留下確切的記載：蒙古軍在1236年之後攻成都、瀘州、興元時用的是傳統拋石砲車，以絞索與人力拋擲石塊；余玠的宋軍則沒有攻城的需求，守方用飛石砲、礌石與滾木對付蒙古修築的攻城土山與雲梯。配重式拋石機成規模地出現在中國戰場，是1260年代襄陽、樊城之役，此後也用於釣魚城，恰好印證了卡面那句話：工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。宋軍守山城倚重的是弓弩與地形：弓以角胎、硬弓為主，弩有蹶張弩、擲臂弩與更重的神臂弓，配合拒馬鹿角、鐵蒺藜、壕溝與木柵，把蒙古騎兵限制在通道裡；山城臨江一面則以礌石、滾木與檣木對付雲梯。蒙古方的攻城裝備包括雲梯、懸梯、鐵撞車與楔木，並用火藥箭與震天雷一類的火器對付城頭守軍，攻城梯上裹氈以防火攻的做法，後來在釣魚城之役留下明確記載。雙方的騎步都靠糧食：宋靠襄漢沿江水運與川中屯田，蒙靠騎兵抄掠與就地徵發。
kitsEn: The counterweight trebuchet on the card is a siege engine that was already mature in twelfth-century Europe: a long beam served as the arm, a counterweight hung at one end and a sling with the stone in it at the other, and when the counterweight fell the stone was whipped over the wall or hurled into the crowded formations inside. Its arrival in China came much later than in Europe, and it is generally held that it was brought over by the artillery experts of Central Asia together with its technique after the Mongol campaigns in the west; the Chinese called it the huihui pao, the counterweight trebuchet of the Central Asians, and the Song History treats it in the section on military equipment as one of the leading siege weapons. On the Sichuan front of 1243 the weapon left no certain trace. When the Mongol armies attacked Chengdu, Luzhou and Xingyuan after 1236 they used the traditional stone-throwing engine worked by ropes and manpower; Yu Jie's Song army had no need of siege engines at all, and the defenders met the Mongol siege ramps and scaling ladders with flying stones, boulders and rolled logs. The counterweight machine appeared on a large scale on Chinese battlefields in the 1260s, in the siege of Xiangyang and Fancheng, and was later used against Diaoyu Fortress, which bears out the sentence on the card: engineering decides a battle before the siege weapons do. What the Song relied on in holding the mountain forts was the bow, the crossbow and the ground itself. The bows were horn-laminated and hardwood weapons; the crossbows came in the windlass type, the thrown type and the heavier shenbi crossbow; and with antlered barricades, iron caltrops, ditches and wooden palisades they shut the Mongol horsemen into narrow lanes. On the face of the forts above the river the defenders used boulders, rolled logs and beams to break scaling ladders. The Mongol siege equipment included scaling ladders, hanging ladders, iron-rammed carts and wedge-shaped battering beams, and they used gunpowder arrows and fire devices of the thunder-thunder bomb type against the defenders on the wall; the practice of sheathing the scaling ladders in wet felt to guard against fire, and the records of that survive from the later siege of Diaoyu Fortress. Food underpinned both the cavalry and the foot on each side: the Song drew it from the river transport out of Jingxiang and from the farms of Sichuan, the Mongols from mounted raiding and from requisitioning on the spot.
tactics: 余玠在四川建立的是一套以工程為核心的守禦體系，後世稱為山城防禦。選點有幾條硬標準：必須扼住江流要津，往來船隻與糧船都繞不過去；必須踞高臨下，敵軍的攻城器械只能從低處往上推；必須有水源、能屯田，城內能自產糧食；還要與鄰近的寨堡互為犄角，敵軍打任何一座，其餘各堡都能出援。宋軍的部署因此呈現出散點式的堡寨網：重慶是樞紐，合州、涪州、夔州各方向的險要山口都有堡塞，川東沿江另有一串據點。具體的守禦動作是：以山城為根本，倚岩築城，前瞰江流，後靠絕壁；城中儲糧、屯田、開鑿水源，城外設壕溝、鹿角與木柵，敵軍必須先填壕、再破柵、再登城，每一步都要用屍首去鋪。守軍不與敵人爭奪平原上的城池，只死守山地堡塞，以逸待勞，等待敵軍攻勢用盡。蒙古的戰術是另一套：分數路入蜀，以騎兵游騎四出，燒掠鄉野，切斷宋軍在平原上的糧源；對已築成的山城則用長圍久困，輪番挑戰，等待守軍疲於奔命，同時在攻城土山頂上架設砲與撞具，試圖一次壓過城頭。1243年這一年的實際形態，是蒙古尚無力專注於蜀中：忽必烈的重心在漠南與荊襄，蜀中攻勢以抄掠與據點鞏固為主，雙方在重慶、夔州一線形成拉鋸。真正決定四川命運的，是余玠的築城速度，而不是任何一場會戰的勝負。
tacticsEn: What Yu Jie built in Sichuan was a system of defence with engineering at its core, later called the defence of the mountain forts. The choice of site followed several hard criteria. A site had to command a river crossing so that no boat or grain barge could pass it; it had to stand above the ground so that the enemy's siege engines could only be pushed up from below; it had to have a water source and land that could be farmed so that the city could feed itself; and it had to work with the neighbouring forts so that whichever one was attacked the others could send help. The Song deployment therefore took the form of a scattered net of forts, with Chongqing as the hub and forts at the dangerous passes in the Hezhou, Fuzhou and Kizhou directions, plus a chain of strongholds along the eastern river. The practical garrison procedure was this: take the mountain fort as the root, build the wall against the rock with the river in front and the sheer cliff behind, store grain, open fields and dig a water source inside the walls, and outside lay a ditch, antlered barricades and a palisade, so that the enemy had to fill the ditch first, break the palisade next and only then climb, and every step of that was paved with bodies. The defenders did not fight the enemy for the cities of the plain at all; they simply held the mountain forts, waiting at ease for the enemy's assault to spend itself. The Mongol method was a different one. They entered Sichuan in several columns, sent their light cavalry out in all directions to burn and plunder the countryside and cut the Song grain supply in the plains, and against the finished mountain forts they used long investment and blockade, rotating challenges to wear the garrison down, while at the same time mounting artillery and rams on the tops of their siege ramps in the hope of overwhelming the wall in a single stroke. The actual shape of the year 1243 was that the Mongols could not yet concentrate on Sichuan: Kublai's attention was in the desert and in Jingxiang, the Sichuan offensive consisted of raiding and of consolidating the points already held, and the two sides settled into a tug of war on the Chongqing and Kizhou lines. What really decided the fate of Sichuan was the rate at which Yu Jie built his fortresses, not the outcome of any single engagement.
data: 可核對的數字有幾個是硬的。時間線最清楚：蒙古軍於1236年攻入川中，成都陷落，曹友聞陣亡；1239年前後宋軍一度收復成都、嘉定；嘉熙六年（1242）末朝廷任命余玠出鎮四川；1243年春余玠率師入蜀、駐重慶；釣魚城自1243年動工，至1246年前後基本建成。地理上，重慶府是川東的總樞紐，合州在重慶之北約二百餘里，釣魚城在合州城東約十餘里，踞嘉陵江、涪江、渠江三江匯流處；重慶至成都沿沱江、涪江水道約數百里，糧秣與援軍的距離，就是余玠最關心的那條數字。制度上，余玠為各城設定的儲糧標準是以三年為額，邊州同時推行屯田，這個數字在後世史家的概括中反覆出現，是山城能夠久守的關鍵。規模方面，史料對蒙古每次入蜀的兵額多不記載，余玠初到時的處境可概括為川兵雖眾而無一分可用；他後來在四川先後修築的山城，通行說法是十餘座，釣魚城、梯山城、勝山城、雲山城、大獲城等是其中較著者。後續可以對照的硬數字有兩個：1259年蒙哥汗攻釣魚城時中流矢死於城下；這座城一直守到1279年，前後三十六年，是有明確紀年的長期抵抗。沒有記載的是各次攻城的雙方損耗人數，以及余玠在1243年前後具體收復了哪些失地。
dataEn: A few of the figures that can be checked are hard. The chronology is the clearest part: the Mongol armies entered Sichuan in 1236, Chengdu fell and Cao Youwen was killed; around 1239 the Song retook Chengdu and Jiading for a time; at the end of the Jiaxi sixth year (1242) the court appointed Yu Jie to command Sichuan; in the spring of 1243 Yu Jie marched into Sichuan and took up his post at Chongqing; work began on Diaoyu Fortress in 1243 and the works were essentially finished by about 1246. In geography, the prefecture of Chongqing was the hub of eastern Sichuan, Hezhou lay some two hundred li north of it, and Diaoyu Fortress stood some ten li east of the city of Hezhou, astride the confluence of the Jialing, the Fu and the Qu rivers. From Chongqing to Chengdu along the waterways of the Tuo and the Fu lay several hundred li, and the distance that carried grain and reinforcements was the number Yu Jie cared about most. In institutional terms, the standard Yu Jie set for the grain stores of the forts was three years, and border prefectures were farmed at the same time; that figure recurs in the later summaries of historians and was the key to the longevity of the mountain forts. On scale, the sources record no troop numbers for the Mongol incursions into Sichuan; Yu Jie's situation on arrival can be put as a host of soldiers in Sichuan and not one usable man among them. The mountain forts he built in Sichuan, by the usual reckoning, numbered a dozen or more, of which Diaoyu, Tishan, Shengshan, Yunshan and Dahuo are the better known. Two hard figures can be set against the later years: in 1259 Möngke Khan was struck by a stray arrow and died at the foot of Diaoyu Fortress, and that fortress was held until 1279, thirty-six years in all, a long resistance with dates attached to it. What is not recorded is the casualty return of the various assaults on either side, nor exactly which lost places Yu Jie recovered in and around 1243.
cause: 余玠入蜀不是因為四川忽然出了戰事，而是因為四川守不住了。1235年之後蒙古大舉南征，蜀中是最先崩潰的方向：成都、嘉定等大城陷落，府庫括盡，軍民死傷流散，全川的人口與生產都遭到毀滅性打擊，川道以內的州縣多淪為蒙古羈縻。端平以來宋廷在北方與江淮屢挫，主流的意見是放棄川陝、退守江淮，川防在人心中已成棄子。第二層是體制上的病。宋廷在四川設宣撫司與制置司，本意是集中兵權，但四川各軍自成一體，將帥互不隸屬，遇敵各自退守，糧餉由各路自籌，調度極難。余玠到任前，朝廷議過幾個名字都沒有結果，最後落在他身上，靠的是他自請出鎮並提出可行的辦法。第三層是進攻方的算盤：蒙古並不急於強攻重慶，而是用招降瓦解宋軍、用抄掠斷宋糧源，劉整降蒙之後更熟悉蜀中情形，其主張的迂迴辦法是先取荊襄、斷宋根本。這意味著余玠的守蜀不是守住幾座城，而是要重建一套能在蒙古持續施壓下自行運轉的防禦體系。還有一層是地理的必然：川中平原上的城市再大也守不住，沒有山地就沒有居高臨下的射界與反傾斜的攻勢，成都與重慶之間的沃野對騎兵毫無遮蔽。余玠的答案因此只有一個方向：把防禦的重心從平原上的城，搬到山上的城。
causeEn: Yu Jie went to Sichuan not because some new outbreak of fighting had occurred there, but because Sichuan could no longer be held. After 1235 the Mongols launched a great campaign to the south, and Sichuan was the first side to collapse: the great cities of Chengdu and Jiading fell, the treasuries were emptied, soldiers and civilians were killed and scattered, the population and the production of the whole province were devastated, and most prefectures and counties inside the Sichuan roads became Mongol dependencies. Since the Duanping era the Song court had been checked repeatedly in the north and along the Huai and the Yangtze, and the prevailing opinion was to abandon Sichuan and Shaanxi and fall back behind the river, so that the defence of Sichuan had become a lost cause in people's minds. The second layer was a disease of the system. The court maintained a xuanfu office and a zhizhi commission in Sichuan with the intention of concentrating command, but in practice each army in Sichuan formed its own body, commanders were subordinate to no one, each retired before the enemy in his own fashion, and each region raised its own money and grain, so that nothing could be moved from one place to another. Before Yu Jie several names were discussed at court and none of them produced a result, and the choice finally fell on him because he asked to be sent there and produced a workable plan. The third layer was the calculation on the attacking side: the Mongols were in no hurry to assault Chongqing by force. They worked to break up the Song army by inducing surrenders and to cut the Song food supply by raiding, and after Liu Zheng's defection they knew the Sichuan situation intimately, and the roundabout scheme he advocated was to take Jingxiang first and cut the Song at the root. All this meant that Yu Jie's defence of Sichuan was not a matter of holding a few cities but of rebuilding a defensive system able to keep turning under continuous Mongol pressure. There was one more layer, and it was geographical necessity. The cities of the Sichuan plain could not be held no matter how large they were; without mountains there was no plunging field of fire and no attack running uphill, and the rich fields between Chengdu and Chongqing offered the cavalry no cover at all. Yu Jie's answer therefore had only one direction to take: move the weight of the defence from the cities of the plain onto the cities of the hills.
impact: 余玠在四川的做法，決定了南宋最後三十餘年的戰局。第一，山城體系讓蒙古第一次在南方碰到打不動的目標。蒙古攻城向來速戰速決，成都、襄陽等大城數月而破，唯獨川東的山堡屢攻不下，1243年之後的每一次進攻都要付出遠高於平原城池的代價，而宋廷因此多取得了三十餘年的時間。第二，它改變了蒙古滅宋的戰略重心。劉整與後來的蒙哥、忽必烈都看清了硬攻川中山寨的代價，於是轉向襄陽、樊城，試圖先斷宋廷的糧道與外援，襄樊之戰隨後成為整場宋蒙戰爭的樞紐，而襄樊失守又反過來抽空了四川的外援。第三，它把中國守城戰從守平原大城推到守山，城防設計因此出現內城隔牆、飛樓、甕城與深壕的新形態，攻城與守城的技術競賽在宋蒙戰爭中打到最高水平。就武器史而言，這段時期也是東西方工程技術第一次在中國戰場上正面相遇：蒙古帶來配重式拋石機、火藥箭、震天雷與更系統的雲梯，宋軍則以神臂弓、礌石、拒馬與山城結構應對。中國後來的城防著作裡，回回砲與山城並列，都是這三十餘年留下的產物。余玠本人的結局則是另一面：他在四川權威太大，關於他的用度與行事，朝中屢有議論，1253年他被罷職召回，蜀人哭之，他在赴任途中病逝，設施與守禦的成果則由後任與守軍延續下去。
impactEn: What Yu Jie did in Sichuan shaped the last thirty years or more of the Southern Song. First, the system of mountain forts was the first time the Mongols in the south met a target they could not move. Mongol sieges had always been short affairs; great cities such as Chengdu and Xiangyang fell within months, and only the mountain forts of eastern Sichuan repeatedly refused to fall, so that every attack after 1243 cost the Mongols far more than the taking of a plain city would have, and the Song court bought itself more than thirty years in exchange. Second, it shifted the strategic centre of the Mongol conquest of Song. Liu Zheng and, after him, Möngke and Kublai all saw the cost of storming the Sichuan strongholds and turned instead towards Xiangyang and Fancheng, seeking to cut the Song court's supply line and its outside aid first; the siege of Xiang and Fan then became the hinge of the entire Song-Mongol war, and its loss drained away the reinforcements that Sichuan had relied on. Third, it moved Chinese siege defence from holding great cities on the plain to holding hills, and fortification design acquired new forms in consequence, with inner partition walls, flying towers, barbicans and deep ditches, while the technical contest between siege and defence was fought at its highest level during the Song-Mongol wars. In the history of weapons this period was also the first time that Eastern and Western engineering had met head on on a Chinese battlefield: the Mongols brought counterweight stone-throwers, gunpowder arrows, thunder bombs and more systematic scaling ladders, and the Song answered with the heavy shenbi crossbow, boulders, antlered barricades and the structure of the mountain forts themselves. In later Chinese writings on fortification, the huihui pao and the mountain fort stand side by side, and both are the product of those thirty-odd years. The fate of Yu Jie himself was the other face of the story: his authority in Sichuan grew very large, his handling of funds and of affairs was repeatedly debated at court, in 1253 he was dismissed and called back, the people of Sichuan wept over him, and he fell ill and died on the road; the works and the defence were carried on by his successors and by the garrisons.
result: 1243年這一年沒有分出勝負，分出的是方向。蒙古軍沒有攻入重慶，也沒有把余玠的防禦體系摧毀；余玠在重慶站住了腳跟，取得對川中軍政的主導權，築城設險、屯田儲糧的工作從這一年開始鋪開，並在此後十餘年間陸續完成十餘座山城的修築。成都、嘉定等大城在這一年仍然不在宋廷手中，蜀地實際上處於蒙軍據點與宋軍堡寨犬牙交錯的狀態，川東沿江一線仍要靠水陸兩路不斷接應。戰術上的結果更為重要：蒙古在四川第一次遇到可以長期固守的縱深，而余玠用山地換來了平原上得不到的射界與補給。這套辦法後來被宋蒙雙方都當作標準，川東山城群成為南宋最後的骨架，釣魚城守到1279年；蒙古則把主攻方向轉向荊襄，間接改變了整場宋蒙戰爭的走向。武器上的結果則是遺憾與啟發並存。配重投石車在1243年的川中還沒有出現，它要等到1260年代才隨襄陽、樊城之役真正落地；宋蒙雙方在這三十餘年裡把注意力放在城牆高度、壕溝深淺、糧儲年限與射擊器械上，攻城武器的成熟反而落在後面。回頭看卡面那句話，確實如此：決定這場戰爭的不是某一門砲，而是有人肯花三年時間在山上築一座城。
resultEn: The year 1243 settled nothing by way of victory or defeat; what it settled was direction. The Mongol armies did not enter Chongqing, and they did not destroy Yu Jie's defensive system. Yu Jie held his ground at Chongqing, took over the direction of military administration in Sichuan, and the work of building forts on natural positions, farming military land and storing grain was set in motion from that year, with more than a dozen mountain forts completed over the following ten years or more. The great cities of Chengdu and Jiading were still not in the Song court's hands in that year; Sichuan in fact lay in a state where Mongol strongholds and Song forts interlocked, and the eastern river line still had to be supplied continuously by water and by land. The tactical result was the more important one: in Sichuan the Mongols met for the first time a depth that could be held for a long time, and Yu Jie had bought the field of fire and the supply that the plain could not give him. His method was afterwards taken by both the Song and the Mongols as the standard, the mountain forts of eastern Sichuan became the last skeleton of the Southern Song, and Diaoyu Fortress was held until 1279; the Mongols swung their main effort towards Jingxiang, which indirectly changed the whole course of the Song-Mongol war. On weapons the outcome was part regret and part instruction. The counterweight trebuchet had not yet appeared in Sichuan in 1243; it only landed for real with the sieges of Xiangyang and Fancheng in the 1260s. Over those thirty-odd years the two sides put their attention on the height of walls, the depth of ditches, the number of years of grain and on missile weapons, and the maturing of siege artillery came after the rest. Looking back at the sentence on the card, it holds true: what decided this war was not one piece of artillery, but the fact that somebody was willing to spend three years building a city on a mountain.
